messages:
Maria: Heads-up: ACME Prod reports SSE stream truncation on /v1/stream. Stream emits ~25-30s of tokens then drops mid-sentence. Client reconnects and gets 502 from ALB. Ticket SUP-8421. Repro with curl --no-buffer. Any immediate thoughts?
Kevin: Can you paste the exact curl and the infra path (Cloudflare/ALB/nginx/envoy)?
Jordan (SRE): +1 need request-id, ALB/target group IDs, and any LB logs. ALB idle timeout defaults to 60s but can show weird half-close behavior.
Ingrid: Customer redacted response: 
```
GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Accept: text/event-stream
Connection: keep-alive

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Content-Type: text/event-stream

data: {\"text\":\"Hello, this is a long response that then...\"}
<TRUNCATED EOF>
```
Maria: My repro steps: 1) curl -v -N "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=gpt-xx" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" 2) let run until it stops (~27s) 3) client reconnect sees 502 from ALB. Observed: upstream closed without app 5xx.
Kevin: Likely proxy buffering or LB idle close. Cloudflare and some HTTP/2 upgrades can cause buffering. Are they on proxied (orange cloud)?
Ingrid: Yes, Cloudflare proxied. CF trace id cfZ-7a1b2c. Also ALB sits in front of our nginx fleet.
Jordan (SRE): Quick checklist: tcpdump ALB->origin on fail, curl from ALB to origin (if access), check nginx: proxy_buffering, proxy_read_timeout, proxy_send_timeout, check envoy http2 codecs if present.
Kevin: Common patterns: nginx with proxy_buffering on will accumulate chunked SSE until buffer thresholds, then flush big blocks -> clients see partial outputs. ALB can close if no bytes perceived for configured idle window even with chunked events between. CF sometimes collapses keepalives.
Maria: I captured tcpdump on the host. Simplified capture shows: 
```
CLIENT -> LB TCP PSH
LB -> ORIGIN TCP PSH
ORIGIN -> LB FIN
LB -> CLIENT RST
```
So LB FINs upstream then RST to client. No app error logged.
Jordan (SRE): That flow matches mid-stream proxy drain / idle close. ALB/CF may half-close while origin still streaming.
Ingrid: Customer-side mitigations tried: server heartbeat every 15s (a single "\n" comment), set nginx: proxy_buffering off, proxy_http_version 1.1, proxy_set_header Connection "", proxy_set_header Keep-Alive "timeout=60". Cloudflare disabled some performance features. Reduced, but not fixed.
Kevin: For durable fix we recommend: Cloudflare - bypass/proxy-disabled for SSE routes or disable HTTP/2 multiplexing to origin; ALB - increase idle timeout to 120s and consider TCP mode/proxy protocol; Nginx - proxy_buffering off, proxy_request_buffering off, proxy_http_version 1.1, chunked_transfer_encoding on, proxy_read_timeout > expected gaps, tcp_nodelay on; Envoy - increase stream_idle_timeout and avoid buffering between HTTP/2->1.1 conversions.
Jordan (SRE): Also check kernel TCP keepalive vs app heartbeats. Some LBs ignore TCP keepalive for idle detection. Good to have an app-level byte every 10-15s.
Maria: Interim we added heartbeat + flush() and emit comment events every 10s. Customer reported 3 hours stable; monitoring for 24h.
Ingrid: Noticed nginx had proxy_buffer_size 32k and proxy_busy_buffers_size 64k on that node. Small SSE writes may be coalesced and interact badly with ALB drain thresholds. Also check gzip: if compression enabled, it will buffer until window fills.
Kevin: KB idea: short doc with sample nginx snippet and recommendations for CF + ALB + nginx stacks. Will draft.
Ingrid: Proposed nginx snippet for KB: 
```
location /v1/stream {
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_request_buffering off;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  chunked_transfer_encoding on;
  proxy_read_timeout 300s;
}
```
Jordan (SRE): Action items: Maria collect pcap (ALB->origin) for time-of-failure; Kevin gather Cloudflare trace + rule IDs; Ingrid collect nginx conf and error logs for the host; escalate to eng-runtime if pattern repeats. Mark P1 for this customer.
support-bot: Linked incident INC-2026 and assigned eng-runtime oncall.
Maria: Uploading pcap + curl output to SUP-8421 now. Customer has heartbeat patch in prod; will monitor 24h and update ticket.
Kevin: If we need quick mitigation for other customers, add SSE route guidance to public KB (heartbeats + proxy_buffering off).
Ingrid: Also recommend a small diagnostic endpoint that emits 1 byte every 10s for 2 minutes to prove path tolerates spaced bytes.
Jordan (SRE): Final note: if path has CF->ALB->nginx, prioritize disabling HTTP/2 between CF and ALB or ensure CF uses origin keepalive. Middle proxies do odd half-close behavior.
Maria: Thanks all — will post final status after 24h stable.
